name: Haus Schernthanner
beschreibung: The Haus Schernthanner is situated in the sunny, peaceful district of Pirchmoos in Söll in the Wilder Kaiser holiday region in Tyrol. This welcoming family-run guesthouse offers alpine country-style guest rooms equipped with private en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and sunny balconies boasting unobstructed views of the rugged Wilder Kaiser cliffs and the Hohe Salve. A wholesome breakfast featuring regional Tyrolean delicacies prepares guests for outdoor adventures each morning. The centre of Söll with its eateries and cafés is an easy walk away. In winter, the complimentary ski bus stops right nearby, whisking winter enthusiasts to the lower gondola station into the expansive SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental in minutes. Summer brings themed adventures like Hexenwasser.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional Tyrolean guesthouse in Pirchmoos in Söll at the Wilder Kaiser with cosy rooms and swift access to the SkiWelt.
